title: kitchenAid cordless hand blender
text: kitchenAid cordless hand blender. Wow.  Super powerful.  I have to admit, I was surprised at the power of this cordless emulsion blender.  It charges quickly - lasts longer than you need before recharge.  There are other pieces too - I purchased 2 other pieces a mixer and a chopper- they all use the same cord for charging and I can't believe much NOT having a cord makes a difference.  Wish I would have done this a long time ago.  KitchenAide is a good brand - may not the best in recent times- but good enough for me to invest in 3 pieces.  I chose the gray.  They are basically plastic with metal pieces.  Time will tell - Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Cordless Variable Speed Hand Blender with Chopper and Whisk Attachment - KHBBV83
features: Blends 25 bowls of soup on a full charge*. With a quick charge of 20 minutes make a Triple Berry smoothie or Tomato Basil Soup.** *Based on 12 ounce bowls (354 ml), 7 batches, Tomato Basil Soup.
Rechargeable Lithium Ion Battery Delivers optimal runtime and performance. Battery Indicator Light signals when it is time to charge the battery.

Easy to charge with convenient charger included, which works on all products across the suite. Charge from empty to full in 2 hours or less. With a quick charge of 20 minutes make a Triple Berry smoothie or Tomato Basil Soup.

Removable 8" Blending Arm with a 4-point Stainless Steel blade design efficiently blends ingredients for smoothies, milk shakes, soups, hummus and so much more. Protect your cookware with the included U.S. patent-pending removable pan guard.
Whisk Attachment to quickly whip egg whites to fluffy peaks and cream, or emulsify, vinaigrettes and mayonnaise.
2.5 Cup BPA-Free* Chopper Attachment to chop herbs, nuts, cheeses and more. *All materials that come into contact with food are BPA free.
Variable speed trigger switch gives you greater flexibility and control over the recipe. The safety switch protects against accidental trigger movement.
Complete Your Cordless Collection with the cordless 5 Cup Food Chopper (KFCB519) and 7 Speed Hand Mixer (KHMB732). Each sold separately.

Includes(1) Blender Arm (dishwasher-safe), (1) 1 Liter BPA-free* pitcher with lid (dishwasher-safe), (1) BPA-Free* Chopper Attachment, (1) Pan Guard (dishwasher-safe), (1) Charger. *All materials that come into contact with food are BPA free.
description: All the power you expect, without the cord. Go where ambition takes you with the cordless hand blender from KitchenAid. Designed with a powerful rechargeable lithium ion battery, the new cordless hand blender delivers optimal runtime and performance, so you can cook wherever*, whatever, and however you choose. Blends 25 bowls of soup on a full charge.** (*Indoor use only. **Based on 12 ounce bowls (354 ml), 7 batches, tomato basil soup. All the power you expect, without the cord.
